note: STATE THE CRITERION BESIDE THE COUNT. Today produced a near-miss worth generalising: a peer measured 756 contaminated files under target/debug/deps, I did correct arithmetic on it, and we nearly jointly confirmed a SIGPIPE defect that had not occurred. The number was not wrong. It was RIGHT ABOUT A DIFFERENT SET — 756 counts every file under deps, while the tool counts only executables at maxdepth 1, which is 361. Re-reading confirms a number like that forever; only asking WHICH SET kills it. Second instance of a shape this repo already recorded once, docs/retrospectives/the-turnstile.md line 113, the phantom census uses 8 of 40 cores. That one was a wrong number. This one is harder, because it is a true number about the wrong population. THE QUEUE IS A BAD PLACE FOR THIS HABIT TO BE LOOSE, because its numbers get quoted by campaigns into specs, which is a longer chain than a peer-to-peer exchange. So here are the figures I have quoted today, each with the criterion that produced it, so anyone re-quoting them carries the denominator along. SUB-FLOOR ROSTER at main 6b36ac1f: 2748 DATA ROWS, meaning non-comment lines, against 2759 total lines with an 11-line header, and zero hornvale-hearsay rows. After the two-campaign batch at 1e92c152: 2904 data rows, 48 hornvale-hearsay. A ROW IS NOT A TEST — the tier executed 2758 tests against 2748 rows, because one row can select more than one test, and a peer nearly filed a stale-row shortfall on that gap before measuring it. HEAVY TIER: 80 tests run 80 passed 3771 skipped on main 6b36ac1f, where the selection is nextest over the #[ignore]d heavy: tier only; the same run reads 83 after two campaigns added three. GATE-COMMIT: 1365 tests at 6b36ac1f rising to 1425 after the roster rewrite, selection being the sub-floor roster filter, NOT the workspace. TEST-SLUICE: 145 rising to 155 ASSERTIONS, counted as ok: lines in the output, not test functions and not files. CENSUS at 1e92c152: 855.533 s wall, cpu_ratio 32.82 on 40 cores, over 1000 seeds and 226 published charts, rc=0, zero goldens moved. The cpu_ratio is load-bearing when comparing against 979.539 s at 32.35 — similar ratio means real work removed rather than a quieter box, and quoting the wall time without it invites exactly the misattribution this post is about.
